place.source_title: Lincoln Hotel, North High & East "A" Streets

brief: Three-storey Greek Revival brick hotel of 1847 on a corner, with a pedimented roofline, pilasters and a ground-floor shopfront; a big hanging sign at the corner. Record: 2 photos plus 6 measured sheets.

facade.notes: the Lincoln Hotel (Belleville IL, 1847): a three-storey stuccoed Greek Revival hotel with a pedimented gable on giant pilasters, a projecting neon 'LINCOLN HOTEL' sign, an ornamental lamp post; on a corner; a water tower behind

why.note: the 1930s neon blade sign on an 1840s hotel
